name: Cyrus Finance CyrusTreasury spot-priced LP withdrawal
summary: CyrusTreasury pays every USDT-denominated exit or reward claim through withdrawUSDTFromAny, which sizes the PancakeSwap V3 liquidity to remove from the pool's current slot0 price and then collects both tokens of the removed liquidity to the claimant. The treasury's ETH/USDT position sat out of range as roughly 562k USDT. The attacker flash-borrowed 1,798 ETH, sold it into the pool to move the price into the bottom of the position's range, and exited a Cyrus position owed 1,707.055 USDT; at that price the position showed only about 1,853 USDT, so the treasury removed 92% of its liquidity and sent the attacker 1,289.35 ETH plus 1,707.055 USDT before the attacker bought the ETH price back and repaid the loan.

loss.notes: Victim depletion is the out-of-range USDT backing of the liquidity the attacker's exit removed from PancakeSwap V3 position 6358139 (range ticks 55318 to 64492, where it holds only USDT): 55986950637933606610065 liquidity x (sqrtRatio(64492) - sqrtRatio(55318)) / 2^96 = 517785.322516154202754603 USDT, less the 1707.055 USDT the exit legitimately owed (Exited event data), = 516078.267516154202754603 USDT. The 1289.3536997589956 ETH the position paid out is not valued separately: the position bought it from the attacker's own 1,798-ETH sale in the same transaction with that USDT. The performance-fee leg (47392230286554365003 liquidity, 1.185199890884981 ETH plus 1.445 USDT to the protocol's fee receiver 0x6cd7bbb8a8c0c1b24a449c3ad8f913974de7b009) stayed with the protocol and is excluded. The attacker EOA netted 28.139762187797007 ETH and 454169.2170373848 USDT (about USD 512k at USD 2061.52 per ETH) after swap fees and the 1.0788 ETH flash fee; SlowMist reports USD 516,840. Nothing was recovered.

ageReset.description: The owner EOA's top-level creation installed the immutable CyrusTreasury runtime containing withdrawUSDTFromAny; the address is not a proxy and its runtime hash was unchanged through the exploit. Later owner changes of the active position (tokenIds[0]) only chose which position the defect could drain.

sources.note: Identity: CyrusTreasury 0xb042ea7b35826e6e537a63bb9fc9fb06b50ae10b is a direct runtime (Etherscan Proxy 0, no delegatecall in the anchor path): eth_getCode is 0x at block 71514302 and 18852 bytes with keccak 0x71bdde471ceabe56f43a88d3717da2f096540380638619c60f4d49dcce7ced46 at 71514303 and 88130289; created by EOA 0xcc64821272e85d49fd66791fef4a662f62dae90b (current owner()) in 0xe62aa648... (tx index 86, receipt contractAddress). The anchor frame CALL 0x938dbbb6 -> 0xb042ea7b (0x7f8661a1) executes this runtime. Age: no proxy or code change exists. Owner configuration history (Etherscan txlist of 0xcc648212... to the treasury): addTokenId(5894330) block 71514316, addTokenId/removeTokenIdByIndex of 6356900, 6358139 and 6385816 in January 2026, then setTokenIdByIndex(0, x) alternating 5894330, 6358139 and 6560166, the last before the exploit setTokenIdByIndex(0, 6358139) in 0x06df1430... (block 87479074, 2026-03-19); getTokenIds() called from the owner returns [6358139] at 88130289. That selection is not an age reset: withdrawUSDTFromAny sizes and collects any active position from its pool's spot price, and every position the owner ever activated (USDT/DOGE, ETH/USDT, CAKE/USDT) paid out only USDT before the anchor, i.e. was an out-of-range USDT position in a PancakeSwap pool, so the choice set only which pool the attacker had to move and how much was exposed. Code age = 1774207284 - 1765637523 = 8569761 s (99.2 days).

Root cause: Etherscan V2 getsourcecode (chainid 56) CyrusTreasury.sol withdrawUSDTFromAny: availableUSDT = getAmountsForLiquidity(IPancakePool(pool).slot0().sqrtPriceX96, ...); liquidityToUse = liquidity * remaining / availableUSDT; decreaseLiquidity then collect(recipient: to, amount0Max/amount1Max: uint128 max), so a same-transaction price move shrinks availableUSDT and the claimant receives both tokens of an oversized removal. Earliest exercise: Etherscan getLogs DecreaseLiquidity (topic0 0x26f6a048..., NonfungiblePositionManager 0x46a15b0b27311cedf172ab29e4f4766fbe7f4364) for every tokenId the treasury ever held (5894330 USDT/DOGE: 45069 events; 6356900 ETH/USDT: 2; 6358139 ETH/USDT: 25533; 6385816 USDT/XRP: 0; 6560166 CAKE/USDT: 7850) from block 71514303 to 88130290: none before the anchor returned any non-USDT token, and the anchor is the only one. After the anchor the owner removed tokenId 6358139 (removeTokenIdByIndex(0), 0x9e66330d..., block 88144648). Loss: positions(6358139) liquidity 60771570367098083451766 at block 88130289 and 4737227498877922476698 at 88130290; the removed attacker-leg liquidity valued with Uniswap TickMath sqrt ratios 1259025813655120638600837768091 (tick 55318) and 1991753336986524243744345230382 (tick 64492) gives 517785.322516154202754603 USDT of pre-attack USDT backing (whole position 562035.02 USDT); minus the 1707.055 USDT owed = 516078.267516154202754603 USDT at par.
